items.question: What percentage reduction in electricity consumption does the Abu Dhabi Energy and Water Efficiency Strategy 2030 aim for by 2030, compared with the 2013 business-as-usual scenario?
items.fact: Abu Dhabi 2030 strategy targets 22% electricity reduction versus 2013
